caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a decorative shield-shaped backrest that features three vertical slats, the central one embellished with a carved motif. The chair is colored in light grayish tones, suggesting painted or lightly stained wood. The seat of the chair is covered with a green fabric that has small patterns of red and yellow flowers and leaves distributed across its surface. The fabric is edged with a yellow zigzag trim. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Chair
